Hi Rudolf,
I have checked the SCB error flags again, and the Power Converter Error has reoccurred.
PowerConverter[2]
PLC
DEVICE
true
2102312VGQKXP2001733SA002200000214FW:DC118PF118H100,F:1,E31

Please verify if the power converter is properly connected to its shelf case.
Check for any loose connections in the power cables or CAN communication cables of the converter. Use a multimeter to measure the voltage across the cables, and check the resistance of the CAN communication cables.
Inspect the display of the power converter to determine whether it is in the OFF or ON state.
Refer to the picture provided above to identify the power converter displaying the error. Try swapping the suspected faulty converter with a known good one. If the error flag shifts to the replaced unit, this indicates that the original converter may be faulty.
If all the steps have been performed and the power converter is still faulty, we recommend replacing it, as reworking it may not be feasible.
Please ensure electrical safety and follow proper PPE guidelines.

additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
Onside visit has been done.
